Class ThermodynamicMigrationEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.ThermodynamicMigrationEngine
public class ThermodynamicMigrationEngine extends Object
Population Migration Vectors by Thermodynamic Free Power Gradients.

Onsager Reciprocal Transport Equations

  Φ_i = (Food_i + Water_i) / (Pop_i + 1)
  ΔΦ_ij = Φ_j - Φ_i
  J_ij = M_0 * ΔΦ_ij * Pop_i
  d(Pop_i)/dt = - ∑_j J_ij
  d(Pop_j)/dt = + ∑_j J_ij
